reuse.why: Reuses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages, isTrackingBudget and the sum-amount sheet cell, but the category selection is copied rather than shared (no shared selector existed; none was introduced).

duplication.why: Copies verbatim the visible/no-goal category SQL, the income-skip guard and the expense sign flip that set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg/setZero already repeat, adding a fifth copy.

placement.why: Action lives in server/budget/actions.ts and is registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: Readable and consistent with neighbours, but the category rule now has another copy to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection helper exists in the tree; the action uses the existing setBudget/getSheetValue layers.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied SQL and income guard in setLastMonthSpending are verbatim copies of set3MonthAvg, not disguised.
